name: Sparkling Wine
description: We have a strong focus on small Champagne producers here. You may have heard the terms "Grower Champagne" or "Farmer Fizz" before. While we don't have a strict policy on whether the Champagne producer only makes wine from fruit they grow, it is where we tend to gravitate. That said, if you want a bottle of Dom, just let us know in the comment section!

name: French Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!
description: When we think about full-bodied French wines, the mind obviously goes towards Bordeaux and Rhone wines. Esteemed bottles from those regions are not uncommon on wine lists around the world and so popular for good reasons. We would also recommend paying special attention to the lesser known reds of southern France: for example, Mourvedre from Bandol, or Carignan from around the Sud-Ouest. We focus our selection on wines that are in 'ready-to-drink' condition, however, many wines under this umbrella could stand be decanted prior to consuming.

name: Italian Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!
description: Trying to organize a wine region defined by nuance and individuality is difficult and foolish, but not necessarily undoable. If you came into the shop and asked for a big Italian wine, we would probably guide you towards Barolo, Barbaresco, Brunello, Taurasi, Amarone, Aglianico del Vulture. If not those wines, wines that drink like that. While not really like one another at all, these wines do share that commonality of more time in oak, stronger tannins, and deeper fruit, whether it be on the earthier or jammier side.

name: Oregon Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!
description: It's no secret that Pinot Noir is the favorite child in Oregon. A few heavier contenders do show up on our shelves every now and then. Bordeaux, Italian, and even some Spanish varietals are grown towards the southern end of the state and in the Columbia Gorge. Might be time to try something new!

name: Washington Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!
description: Washington is definitely known for strong, powerful wines, typically made with Bordeaux or Rhone varietals. While extraction and use of oak may be liberal among many producers, we aim to offer a selection of balanced wines that provide familiar aromas and flavors that a fan of our local wines enjoy. Big, juicy Cabs and peppery, smoky Syrahs will be in your future if you choose this option.

name: Miscellaneous countries and their fantastic wines!
Spanish Wine
description: We've all become intimately familiar with the great Rioja's in the market, but many of us are starting to discover beautiful, bold, and hearty wines from Priorat or Montsant. Delicious, spicy, tannic reds that go great with grilled meats in the summer or beefy stews in winter.

name: Specialty Wine
description: Whether you're making cocktails or just want something to sip on over ice with an orange slice, we've got all your vermouth needs covered!
